entities.name: René Henry Gracida
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: René Henry Gracida is an American Catholic prelate who served as bishop of Corpus Christi in Texas from 1983 to 1997. He previously served as Bishop of Pensacola-Tallahassee in Florida (1975–1983) and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Miami in Florida (1971–1975).

entities.summary: René Henry Gracida is an American Catholic prelate who served as bishop of Corpus Christi in Texas from 1983 to 1997. He previously served as Bishop of Pensacola-Tallahassee in Florida (1975–1983) and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Miami in Florida (1971–1975).
